name: laravel-best-practices
title_zh: 写 Laravel 时顺手把 N+1 和越权堵在提交
tagline_zh: 写控制器、模型、迁移、队列任务时它都在旁边盯着：预加载漏了、策略没挂、缓存键撞了，当场指出来。
tagline_en: It watches every controller, model, migration and job you write, flagging missing eager loads, unwired policies.
desc_en: Apply this skill whenever writing, reviewing, or refactoring Laravel PHP code. This includes creating or modifying controllers, models, migrations, form requests, policies, jobs, scheduled commands, service classes, and Eloquent queries. Triggers for N+1 and query performance issues, caching strategies, authorization and security patterns, validation, error handling, queue and job configuration, r
why_zh: 覆盖的是整条 Laravel 写法链，不是零散技巧清单。它按框架惯例判断。
why_en: It covers the whole Laravel writing chain, not a scattered tip list, and reasons from framework conventions — so it flags.
limit_zh: 只针对 Laravel 惯例，不认 Lumen、Symfony 或原生 PHP 写法；不跑测试也不连数据库。
limit_en: Laravel conventions only — not Lumen, Symfony or vanilla PHP. It never runs tests or touches your DB, so N+1 calls are inferred from code, not.
title_en: Catch N+1 and auth holes while you write Laravel
